metaTitle: ConstruFácil: your home in Honduras, built from the United States
metaDescription: Buy or build your home in Honduras from the United States. You see every update in photos and pay for each stage when you see it finished.

hero.title: Your home in Honduras, built from the United States
hero.subtitle: See every update in photos. Pay for each stage when you see it finished.

points.stages: You pay for each stage when you see the progress
points.photos: Photos and videos of your build every week

readyHome.title: Ready homes
readyHome.description: Buy a finished home, one under construction or a presale. You see its documents before you pay.

build.title: Build
build.description: Create your project: with or without land, with your plans or one of our designs. Experts guide you at every stage.

quote.title: You create your project
quote.body: You choose land, design and materials for each stage. You instantly see what each stage costs and how long it takes.

call.title: We talk and you sign
call.body: On a video call we review your land and your questions. You sign the contract with the final price.

build.title: We build and show you
build.body: Every week you get photos and videos of your build. Your family in Honduras can go see it.

pay.title: You pay for what you see
pay.body: Each payment is made when you see the previous stage finished. At the end, we hand you the keys.

calculator.title: How long will it take with what you send each month?

trust.title: Your money, always in sight
trust.intro: We know many people have lost money sending it home to build. That's why we work like this:

stages.title: Payment by stage
stages.body: You never prepay the whole build. Each payment matches a stage you already saw finished.

contract.title: Contract before we start
contract.body: Price, stages, timelines and guarantees in writing, signed before the first payment.

documents.title: Reviewed paperwork
documents.body: We show you the title deed and the lien-free certificate before any payment.

accounts.title: Company accounts only
accounts.body: We will never ask you to deposit into a person's account. Every payment has its receipt.

trust.showcaseNote: Real before-and-after photos of our builds go here. In the meantime, we show example illustrations.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.note: Example testimonials. They will be replaced with real testimonials, with each client's permission.

carlos.quote: From Houston I saw the photos every week. When they finished the roof, I paid for the next stage without fear.
carlos.name: Carlos M.

wendy.quote: My mom went to the site every Saturday and I saw the same thing in the portal. I finally felt my money was going into something of mine.
wendy.name: Wendy R.
wendy.place: Charlotte, North Carolina · home in La Ceiba

jose.quote: We bought the land and the house in the same process. They explained every document before we paid.
jose.name: José and Marta A.
jose.place: New York · land and home in Comayagua

finalCta.title: Shall we start your home?
finalCta.body: Create your project in a few minutes or message us on WhatsApp. We reply within one business day.
